mail.reads_out_body: Everything else. Hour only asks your mailbox about your contacts' addresses: the rest is neither read nor stored.
mail.reads_who_body: Whoever sees the conversation in the space. If you mark it private, only you.
mail.personal_hint: Only you send from it. What it brings in is seen by whoever sees that conversation.
mail.shared_hint: An admin connects it and the team shares it: what it brings shows up in the contact's conversation, and whoever edits that conversation can send from it.

mail.disconnected: Mailbox disconnected. Emails already brought in stay.

help.concept.scope_body: What you see across all four sections. "All" is everything you have; narrow it to a space, a show, a line or a person and Today, Planner, Conversations and Books narrow with it.
help.concept.scope_body@music: What you see across all four sections. "All" is everything you have; narrow it to a space, a project, a line or a person and Today, Planner, Conversations and Books narrow with it.
help.concept.scope_body@mixed: What you see across all four sections. "All" is everything you have; narrow it to a space, a project, a line or a person and Today, Planner, Conversations and Books narrow with it.
desk.calm_rest_one: 1 more, the season and what changed wait outside calm
desk.calm_rest_many: {n} more, the season and what changed wait outside calm
planner.calm_uncounted: Confirmed only; the options wait outside calm
planner.calm_season_rest: What is not closed, the gaps and the absences wait outside calm
conversations.calm_rest: The list, the season and the team’s threads wait outside calm
books.calm_rest: The other figures, the month-by-month inflow and the book wait outside calm
calm.announce_on: Calm on: each section shows only today and what is waiting for you
help.concept.calm_body: Another way of looking, not a grey filter. Today: one column with today’s things; the overdue in one line that opens it. Planner: only what is confirmed, with the options counted. In the sidebar, “Next” names only what is confirmed. Conversations: only what is our turn; Books: what comes in and what needs attention. Nothing is deleted: what it hides is said in one line, and a clash still shows.
help.concept.guess_body: A question mark or "deduced" means nobody entered it: Hour assumes it from the cities.
help.concept.waiting_body: What needs something from you: tasks, replies you owe, two holds on the same day to decide, and overdue payments. It goes by day, overdue first; what comes later fits in one line that opens. The number in the title counts these; what Hour suggests sits apart and doesn’t add up.
help.concept.changed_body: What happened since your last visit: who replied, new messages in team threads, mailouts and payments. The first time, the last week.
help.concept.hold_body: A date pencilled in with the venue, not confirmed yet. "1st hold" means you’re first in line for that day; if the performance has a notice period, Hour reminds you when to decide.
help.concept.hold_body@music: A date pencilled in with the venue, not confirmed yet. "1st hold" means you’re first in line for that day; if the show has a notice period, Hour reminds you when to decide.
help.concept.hold_body@mixed: A date pencilled in with the venue, not confirmed yet. "1st hold" means you’re first in line for that day; if the date has a notice period, Hour reminds you when to decide.
help.concept.decide_body: Two dates wanting the same day, at least one on hold: you have to pick. If you’ve already confirmed one, Hour asks whether to release the other. The number counts pairs, not dates.
help.concept.clashes_body: What can’t happen: the same person in two places on the same day, or someone unavailable when needed. If a performance has no cast, Hour can’t tell and doesn’t count it as a clash.
help.concept.clashes_body@music: What can’t happen: the same person in two places on the same day, or someone unavailable when needed. If a show has no band, Hour can’t tell and doesn’t count it as a clash.
help.concept.clashes_body@mixed: What can’t happen: the same person in two places on the same day, or someone unavailable when needed. If a performance or show has no cast or band, Hour can’t tell and doesn’t count it as a clash.
help.concept.unclosed_body: Confirmed performances in the next 8 weeks still missing something: the time, the hotel, the tech or who goes. "2 of 9" is how many of the confirmed are missing something. "Travel?" is Hour’s guess and doesn’t count.
help.concept.unclosed_body@music: Confirmed shows in the next 8 weeks still missing something: the time, the hotel, the tech or who goes. "2 of 9" is how many of the confirmed are missing something. "Travel?" is Hour’s guess and doesn’t count.
help.concept.unclosed_body@mixed: Confirmed dates in the next 8 weeks still missing something: the time, the hotel, the tech or who goes. "2 of 9" is how many of the confirmed are missing something. "Travel?" is Hour’s guess and doesn’t count.
help.concept.gaps_body: Three nights or more in a row with nothing in the next 12 weeks: room for a deal. Tour days and company closures don’t count as free.
help.card.desk_body: What needs attention today, across everything. At the top, today and what’s coming; then what’s waiting for you and what changed; last, a door to each section.
help.card.desk_step_1: Today in order, with what’s on now (or next) open large, and below, “After”: the next three on other days. If nothing is left today, the headline names what’s next.
help.card.desk_step_2: What you have to do this week, overdue first. Once done, it’s gone.
help.card.desk_step_3: What’s new since your last visit and a door to each section with its number. Tap one to go in.
help.card.planner_body: The next 12 weeks at a glance: what’s confirmed, on hold, clashing, and where the gaps are. Agenda, Month and Board are other ways of seeing the same thing; tap a day to see all of it.
help.card.planner_step_1: Each day is a cell: a solid edge is confirmed, a dashed edge is on hold. The key below explains the rest.
help.card.planner_step_2: What needs sorting: dates competing for the same day, and what can’t happen.
help.card.planner_step_3: What’s confirmed but still missing something, and the free nights where a deal would fit.
help.event.first_clash: The red dot is a clash: something that can’t happen this way. Open it to see who’s missing or who’s in two places.
help.event.first_hold_due: It’s time to decide on this hold. Confirm or release it: the venue is waiting too.
help.event.first_trip_guess: "Travel?" is a guess: the performance is far from home and there’s no route. Add the travel and it goes away.
help.event.first_trip_guess@music: "Travel?" is a guess: the show is far from home and there’s no route. Add the travel and it goes away.
help.event.first_trip_guess@mixed: "Travel?" is a guess: the date is far from home and there’s no route. Add the travel and it goes away.
help.concept.due_body: Someone wrote or called and you haven’t answered yet, or a follow-up is due. If no answer is needed, "Needs no reply" takes it off this list.
help.concept.cold_body: Two cases: 21 days with no reply to your last email ("No reply to the mailout" if it was a mailout), or 30 days with nothing moving in an open conversation ("Stalled").
help.concept.season_sales_body: September to August. It counts conversations with a performance that season, or none yet, with one bar per working line: "40 · 12 replied" is that line’s total and how many have replied; the bar splits them by relation, and their deals on hold and confirmed sit alongside. Those "without a contact date" predate the history: we don’t know when you last spoke.
help.concept.season_sales_tap: Pick a line or a status to filter the list.
help.concept.season_sales_body@music: September to August. It counts conversations with a show that season, or none yet, with one bar per working line: "40 · 12 replied" is that line’s total and how many have replied; the bar splits them by relation, and their deals on hold and confirmed sit alongside. Those "without a contact date" predate the history: we don’t know when you last spoke.
help.concept.season_sales_body@mixed: September to August. It counts conversations with a date that season, or none yet, with one bar per working line: "40 · 12 replied" is that line’s total and how many have replied; the bar splits them by relation, and their deals on hold and confirmed sit alongside. Those "without a contact date" predate the history: we don’t know when you last spoke.
help.concept.relation_body: Where you stand with this venue. Hour works it out from the history; you don’t set it by hand, except "Not this time". Dates, holds and confirmations belong to its deals, shown on the page.
help.concept.relation_body@music: Where you stand with this venue or promoter. Hour works it out from the history; you don’t set it by hand, except "Not this time". Dates, holds and confirmations belong to its deals, shown on the page.
help.concept.relation_body@mixed: Where you stand with this venue or promoter. Hour works it out from the history; you don’t set it by hand, except "Not this time". Dates, holds and confirmations belong to its deals, shown on the page.
help.concept.relation_not_now: they’ve said no for now. You set it; it leaves mailouts and "gone quiet", and lifts by itself when they write again or on the day you pick.
help.concept.relation_regular: you’ve done a deal with them in an earlier season, with any show. It stays so even if they go quiet.
help.concept.relation_regular@music: you’ve done a deal with them in an earlier season, with any project. It stays so even if they go quiet.
help.concept.relation_regular@mixed: you’ve done a deal with them in an earlier season, with any project. It stays so even if they go quiet.
help.concept.relation_talking: they’ve replied and something moved in the last 30 days.
help.concept.relation_dormant: you talked, but nothing has moved for over 30 days.
help.concept.relation_contacted: you’ve written and they haven’t replied yet. Those from before the history count here, undated.
help.concept.relation_never: nobody has written to them yet.
help.concept.relation_more: If two apply, the higher one wins: a regular venue that goes quiet stays regular, and "Gone quiet" shows the silence.
help.concept.bolo_body: The agreement with a venue: one or more performances, a fee, an invoice. Money hangs on the deal, not the performance, and it becomes "to invoice" after its last performance.
help.concept.bolo_body@music: The agreement with a venue: one or more shows, a fee, an invoice. Money hangs on the deal, not the show, and it becomes "to invoice" after its last show.
help.concept.bolo_body@mixed: The agreement with a venue: one or more dates, a fee, an invoice. Money hangs on the deal, not on each date, and it becomes "to invoice" after its last date.
help.concept.to_collect_body: Invoiced, not yet paid. An invoice becomes overdue on the day you expected payment or, with no date, 60 days after it was issued.
help.concept.next30_body: Payments you expect over the next month, from each invoice’s expected date. A forecast, not money in the bank.
help.concept.season_books_body: September to August. The bar splits what’s sold into collected, invoiced but unpaid, and contracted but not invoiced. What follows, "in progress", is holds and proposals: it doesn’t count yet.
help.concept.board_body: One thread per topic: tech, logistics, money, meals… Each topic is seen by whoever has permission for it, so not everyone on the team reads the same things.
help.concept.cast_body: Who goes to this performance. It decides who appears on the road sheet and gets the notice, and it’s what lets Hour spot a clash: with no cast, it can’t.
help.concept.cast_body@music: Who plays this show. It decides who appears on the road sheet and gets the notice, and it’s what lets Hour spot a clash: with no band, it can’t.
help.concept.cast_body@mixed: Who goes to this performance or show. It decides who appears on the road sheet and gets the notice, and it’s what lets Hour spot a clash: with no cast or band, it can’t.
help.concept.roadsheet_body: What the team and the venue need to know about the day: times, address, contacts. Shared by a link that opens without an account.
help.concept.lines_body: The ways a show is taken out: a campaign, a territory, a season ("MaMeMi 26-27 Catalunya"). Each conversation can belong to a line, and the Venues season is split by line.
help.concept.lines_body@music: The ways a project is taken out: a campaign, a territory, a season ("MaMeMi 26-27 Catalunya"). Each conversation can belong to a line, and the Venues season is split by line.
help.concept.lines_body@mixed: The ways a project is taken out: a campaign, a territory, a season ("MaMeMi 26-27 Catalunya"). Each conversation can belong to a line, and the Venues season is split by line.
help.concept.trade_body: Stage or live music. It changes a few words across the space: performance or show, cast or band, programmer or promoter. The data stays the same.
help.concept.mailboxes_body: Which connected mailboxes this conversation’s emails come from: yours or the space’s shared one. Hour only brings in email with its contacts’ addresses, and whoever sees the conversation sees it; if it’s private, only you.
help.concept.known_body: Your own mark on this person, not on the venue: if they move to another venue, you still know them. It starts private; share it if you want the team to know who to call. It doesn’t open access to anything.
help.concept.known_body@music: Your own mark on this person, not on the venue or promoter: if they move on, you still know them. It starts private; share it if you want the team to know who to call. It doesn’t open access to anything.
help.concept.known_body@mixed: Your own mark on this person, not on the venue or promoter: if they move on, you still know them. It starts private; share it if you want the team to know who to call. It doesn’t open access to anything.
help.card.conversations_body: Every conversation, as in a messaging app: who with, the last word, how many unread and whose turn it is. The chips filter the same list; what goes out to many is in Mailouts.
help.card.conversations_step_1: Our turn: the ones that wrote to us and are still waiting. First thing each day.
help.card.conversations_step_2: The list: what is new on top, then our turn. Open one to read and reply.
help.card.conversations_step_3: All of them, with relation and reply. From here you write to several at once.
help.card.team_body: What the company says among itself: deal boards and each venue’s team thread. Newest at the top. You write inside each deal or venue.
help.card.books_body: The money, deal by deal: what’s sold, invoiced and collected this season, and what needs attention.
help.card.books_admin: If you don’t invoice in Hour, you can turn Books off in Settings → Sections.
help.card.books_step_1: To collect, to invoice, the next 30 days and the season. All but the 30-day one filter the list.
help.card.books_step_2: Overdue invoices and deals done without an invoice, most urgent first.
help.card.books_step_3: Deals is each agreement with its money; Documents is the invoices and payments themselves.
help.event.first_reply_waiting: Someone wrote and it stays here until you answer. If no answer is needed, "Needs no reply" removes it.
help.event.first_team_thread: This is from the team: what’s written on a deal board or a venue’s team thread. Whoever has permission for that topic sees it.
help.event.first_overdue: This invoice is past the date you expected payment. Once paid, log it and it leaves this list.
help.event.first_payment: Payment logged: "To collect" goes down and collected grows in the season bar.
help.event.first_board: Each topic is a thread, seen by whoever has permission for it. Write in the right one.
help.event.first_mail_synced: Hour brought this email in from a connected mailbox, because the address belongs to a contact. Whoever sees this conversation sees it.
